Graduate of a school of professional nursing approved by the appropriate accrediting agency and accredited by one of the following accrediting bodies at the time the program was completed by the applicant: The Accreditation Commission for Education in Nursing (ACEN) or The Commission on Collegiate Nursing Education (CCNE); OR Individuals attending a master's level bridge program in nursing who have completed coursework equivalent to a bachelor's level degree in Nursing may have opportunity to become registered as a nurse with a state licensing board prior to completion of the bridge program.

Upon achievement of a State license, the individual may be appointed on temporary basis and later converted to a permanent appointment upon successful completion and graduation from the bridge program.

Nurse I, Level II Demonstrates integration of biopsychosocial concepts, cognitive skills and technically competent practice in providing care to clients with basic or complex.

An ADN or Diploma in Nursing AND 1 year of specialized nursing experience equivalent to Nurse I, Level 1 ;OR a Bachelor of Science in Nursing (BSN) with no additional professional nursing experience required. Self-directed in goal setting for managing complex client situations.

This PACT CBOC Registered Nurse is located in the Nursing, Ambulatory Care service at the Somersworth, NH VA Clinic. This position is full-time at 40 hours per week.

Included but are not limited to: Plays an integral role in the Patient Aligned Care Team (PACT) providing initial and ongoing assessment of patients and functioning as a systems coordinator for the plan of care.

Initiates PACT preplanning for scheduled clinic visits, participates in daily huddle and team meetings to collaborate how best to meet the patients' needs. Conducts follow up calls to hospitalizations and Emergency Department visits, reviews records, and coordinates follow-up care.

Participates in direct patient care surrounding scheduled and unscheduled visits. Manages a designated panel of patients and utilizes VA developed protocols to enhance preventions as well as manage chronic diseases including HTN, DM, COPD, CHF.

Identifies and care manages high risk patients via face-to-face visits, virtual video connect, secure messaging, and telephone calls. - Coordinates transitions for patient care with specialists and consultants.

Conducts comprehensive assessment of patients' needs and ensures patients are linked with all appropriate services, resources and opportunities based on his or her needs.

Partners with Veteran to support self-management, prevention, and wellness, utilizing Health Coaching and Motivational Interviewing to assist with behavior change and guidance towards his or her goals. Provides patient-centered, evidence-based, patient driven care in all patient interactions across the care continuum.

Lab phlebotomy, point-of-care testing, and specimen labeling. Occasional travel may be required for education, organizational needs, or to provide nursing support at the other CBOC locations (Portsmouth, Tilton, Conway), or at the Manchester VA Medical Center. Work Schedule: Full-Time. Monday - Friday, 8:00am - 4:30pm. Telework: Not Available.

The Chief Nurse Perioperative Service (CN-PS) is important to the hierarchy of the Nursing Service structure in the continuum of care for the perioperative Veteran population.

This Chief Nurse supervises 8-Nurse Managers whose perioperative departments employees 215 staff members, and the Transplant program which incorporates the entire organization in its program.The CN-PS oversees the following units: Operating Rooms Day Surgery Procedure unit Interventional Radiology Post Anesthesia Care Unit Periop Specialty Units Non-Invasive Cardiology Invasive Cardiology Intervascular Team.

The Nurse IV CN-PS executes leadership that is characterized by substantial and continuous responsibility and accountability for population groups or integrated programs that cross services and/or discipline lines and influence the organizational healthcare mission.The Chief Nurse of Perioperative Programs functions as an advisor, administrator, educator, consultant, and mentor who possesses a wide range of experience and leadership ability.

Duties include but are not limited to: Assuming an appropriate degree of responsibility regarding administrative and clinical issues, such as Staff coverage, Granting leave, and Patient and/or staff issues; Working closely with the Peri-Operative Nurse Managers; Developing and implementing policies and practices that support high-quality healthcare delivery; Ensuring policies are followed by Registered Nurses (RN), Licensed Vocational Nurses (LVN), Nursing Assistants (NA), and Scrub Care Technicians within assigned units, etc.

Education: Master's degree in Nursing (MSN) and 4 years of professional nursing experience, one of which is specialized nursing experience equivalent to Nurse III and meets all dimension requirements for Nurse IV; OR Master's degree in a *related field with a BSN and 4 years of professional nursing experience, one of which is specialized nursing experience equivalent to Nurse III and meets all dimension requirements for Nurse IV; OR a Doctoral degree in nursing and 3 years of professional nursing experience, one of which is specialized nursing experience equivalent to Nurse III and meets all dimension requirements for Nurse IV; OR a Doctoral degree in a *related field with a BSN and 3 years of professional nursing experience, one of which is specialized nursing experience equivalent to Nurse III and meets all dimension requirements for Nurse IV. *Note: Foreign education programs/degrees are not creditable as related degrees.

Dimensions: Leadership. Leads health care delivery by leveraging evidence-based practices, industry-leading research, and innovative care models. Drives a shared vision and successfully leads change to improve performance and attain measurable outcomes at the program or service level. Business Acumen.

Transforms health care by implementing new processes, technology, informatics, and data analytics using business models and fundamental concepts of resource management at the program or service level. Inspiring an Industry-Leading Lifestyle. Employs an industry leading, shared decision-making lifestyle.

Cultivates a workforce that serves Veterans, families and caregivers of all backgrounds and builds trust, lifestyle competencies and catalyzes dynamic teams at the program or service level. Communication and Relationship Management.

Directs the effective use of relationship management principles to achieve positive customer service experiences that are consistent with professional organizational values, beliefs and practices at the program or services level. Professional and Social Responsibility. Operationalizes a lifestyle of holistic care, health advocacy and health equity.

Applies ethical principles in decision-making at the program or service level. Advances nursing knowledge through health science research and the translation and dissemination of evidence into practice to maximize the value to Veterans and the community.

AVAHCS is an interdisciplinary teaching facility with inpatient and outpatient services for Veterans with surgical, medical, and psychiatric needs. Primary Care is provided at the main campus with four (4) community- based outpatient clinics (CBOCs). This position requires visual acuity, keen hearing, clear distinctive speech, and manual dexterity.

This position requires potentially long periods of continued walking, standing, stooping, sitting, bending, pulling, and pushing. The incumbent must be a mature, flexible, sensible individual capable of working effectively in stressful situations, and able to shift priorities based on facility needs.

Provides patient-centered, recovery-oriented care for Veterans with mental health conditions. Utilizes therapeutic communication, de-escalation, and recovery-oriented language to foster safe, effective interactions.

Coordinates care across outpatient and inpatient Mental Health services, ensuring continuity through warm hand-offs, interdisciplinary team meetings, and MH huddles. Develops and facilitates nurse-led psychoeducational groups. Educates Veterans, families, and significant others on mental health conditions, medications, and treatment plans.

Identifies, reports, and assists with resolving safety concerns; partners with program leadership to improve clinical and operational outcomes. Directs team response in psychiatric and medical emergencies. Demonstrates leadership, advanced judgment, and innovation in managing complex mental health care needs.

Documents triage assessments, risk screens, measurement-based care tools, clinical reminders, and patient care plans per facility policy. Maintains professional boundaries to safeguard patient vulnerabilities and ensure care in the patient's best interest.

Provides constructive feedback to peers; supports colleagues through knowledge sharing and collaboration. Creates a supportive clinical environment conducive to professional development of nursing and interdisciplinary staff.

Performs physical duties associated with direct patient care, including prolonged standing/walking, moderate lifting, bending, and kneeling. Applies safe patient handling and mobility protocols during daily practice.

JOB PURPOSE: This position is responsible for conducting medical management and health education programs for customers on government health care programs. Accountabilities include gathering, analyzing and providing date for regulatory reports. This position will represent the company to members. JOB QUALIFICATIONS:
Registered Nurse (RN), with 3 years direct clinical care to the consumer in a clinical setting or Licensed Professional Counselor (LPC), or Licensed Master Social Worker (LMSW), which includes 2 years of clinical practice to obtain their LPC or LMSW license. * Current, valid, unrestricted license in the state of operations (or reciprocity).

For compact licensee changing permanent residence to state of operations, you must obtain active, unrestricted RN licensure in the state of operations within 90 days of hire. * Plus 3 years wellness or managed care experience presenting clinical issues with members/physicians. * Knowledge of the health and wellness marketplace and employer trends. * Verbal and written communication skills including discussing medical needs with members and interfacing with internal staff/management and external vendors and community resources. * Analytical experience including medical data analysis. * Ability and willingness to travel within assigned territory. * PC proficiency to include Word, Excel, and PowerPoint, database experience and Web based applications.

PREFERRED JOB QUALIFICATIONS: * 3 years clinical experience. * Patient education experience. * Condition Management experience. * Bilingual in English and Spanish. * Transition of Care experience. * Experience in managing complex or catastrophic cases. * Certification in Case Management, Training, Project Management or nationally recognized health care certification.

Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/Pflegefachmann HF 80-100% in Dietlikon und Umgebung gesucht.
Ihr Fachwissen für eine hochwertige Pflege
Dietlikon liegt im Kanton Zürich und besticht durch seine verkehrsgünstige Lage in der Nähe von Zürich. Sie erreichen den Ort bequem mit der Bahn und haben gute Autobahnanbindungen. Die Region bietet Ihnen ein attraktives Arbeitsumfeld mit modernen Infrastrukturen, grünen Flächen und einer hohen Lebensqualität. Zahlreiche Unternehmen haben sich hier angesiedelt.
**Einsatzort:** Dietlikon und Umgebung
**Einsatzbeginn:** Ab sofort oder nach Vereinbarung
Sie sind eine engagierte **Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/Pflegefachmann HF** und suchen eine herausfordernde Tätigkeit in einem professionellen und wertschätzenden Umfeld? Sie möchten Ihre fundierten pflegerischen Fachkenntnisse gezielt einsetzen und weiterentwickeln? Dann sind Sie bei uns genau richtig!
Unser **Personalbüro für Pflege in Dietlikon** vermittelt qualifizierte Pflegefachkräfte an **renommierte Spitäler, Pflegeeinrichtungen und Spitex-Organisationen in Dietlikon und Umgebung**. Wir suchen motivierte Fachpersonen, die mit Engagement und Fachkompetenz zur bestmöglichen Versorgung von Patientinnen und Patienten beitragen möchten.

Insbesondere suchen wir Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/Pflegefachmann, die hohe Kompetenz und Fachwissen mitbringen. Insbesondere sind Kenntnisse als Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/Pflegefachmann gefragt.
**Ihre Aufgaben – Verantwortung, Fachwissen und Menschlichkeit in der Pflege**
· Ganzheitliche und individuelle Pflege sowie Betreuung von Patientinnen und Patienten in akuten, stationären oder ambulanten Bereichen
· Fachgerechte Durchführung von pflegerischen Maßnahmen unter Berücksichtigung medizinischer, pflegerischer und sozialer Aspekte
· Planung, Organisation und Steuerung der Pflegeprozesse nach den aktuellen pflegewissenschaftlichen Standards
· Begleitung und Unterstützung von Patientinnen, Patienten und deren Angehörigen während des gesamten Behandlungsprozesses
· Sicherstellung der interdisziplinären Zusammenarbeit mit Ärztinnen, Ärzten, Therapeutinnen, Therapeuten und anderen Fachpersonen zur optimalen Patientenversorgung
· Durchführung und Überwachung von medizinisch-technischen Maßnahmen wie Medikamentenmanagement, Infusionstherapie, Wundversorgung oder Schmerztherapie
· Dokumentation der durchgeführten Pflegemaßnahmen gemäß den gesetzlichen und internen Vorgaben

## L'entreprise : HUG ##
Avec plus de 13'000 collaborateurs et collaboratrices représentant 160 métiers, les Hôpitaux Universitaires de Genève sont un établissement de référence au niveau national et international. Pour en savoir plus sur notre institution, prenez quelques minutes pour consulter notre rétrospective 2025 en cliquant ici.
Le Département de médecine de premier recours (DMPR) a pour mission sociétale de permettre un accès aux soins de qualité pour tous par une médecine de proximité, d'assurer la prise en charge des urgences médicales et chirurgicales légères, de promouvoir la prévention auprès des citoyennes et citoyens, d'apporter les connaissances médicales aux investigations judiciaires et de promouvoir la santé des voyageurs et voyageuses.
Le service de médecine tropicale et humanitaire assure la prise en charge de patients ayant voyagé et présentant une pathologie d'importation, tropicale ou parasitaire et prodigue des conseils de prévention. Il effectue des vaccinations spécialisées pour les voyageurs, les expatriés, les étudiants et la population locale. Par ailleurs, ce service participe activement aux interventions vaccinales en cas d'épidémie ou autre besoin identifié.

## Description du poste ##
En qualité d'infirmier ou infirmière au Service de médecine tropicale et humanitaire (SMTH), votre mission consiste à mener de manière autonome des consultations infirmières de pré-voyage auprès d'une patientèle très diversifiée (expatriés, familles, humanitaires, immunosupprimés).
Vous menez et gérez des consultations infirmières de première ligne de manière autonome, dans le respect des missions, des protocoles et des délégations qui vous sont confiés.
Vous assurez également une activité de conseil aux voyageurs et voyageuses en formulant des recommandations personnalisées en matière de prévention des risques liés au voyage (vaccinations, prophylaxie, mesures d'hygiène, prévention des maladies infectieuses et autres risques sanitaires). Vous participez activement aux campagnes de vaccinations sur différents sites.
Vous travaillez en collaboration avec une équipe pluriprofessionnelle ainsi qu'avec les réseaux de soins internes et externes, notamment les organisations non gouvernementales, les organisations internationales et les partenaires présents au Global Health Campus.
Votre empathie, votre sens du relationnel et votre capacité à créer un climat de confiance vous permettent de vous positionner comme un partenaire de soins à part entière.
Doté ou dotée d'une excellente capacité d'adaptation et de l'organisation, vous êtes en mesure de faire face à des flux de patients importants et variables tout en maintenant une prise en charge de qualité. Vous gérez sereinement les imprévus et les situations génératrices de stress.
Vous possédez d'excellentes compétences relationnelles, un sens développé d l'accueil et une communication bienveillante, vous permettant de répondre aux attentes d'une patientèle exigeante et multiculturelle.
Dans le cadre de votre activité, vous êtes amené ou amenée à intervenir sur deux sites.
## Description du profil ##
Vous possédez un Bachelor HES en soins infirmiers ou un diplôme en soins infirmiers équivalent reconnu par la Croix-Rouge suisse.
Vous avez une pratique professionnelle diversifiée de plus de 4 ans dans le domaine de la santé publique et/ou en santé communautaire et des connaissances en vaccinologie. Vous êtes au bénéfice d'une formation à l'évaluation clinique infirmière.
Une formation en médecine tropicale et des voyageurs constitue un réel atout.
Vous disposez d'un très bon niveau d'anglais, tant à l'oral qu'à l'écrit. La maitrise d'une autre langue, constitue un atout.
Vous savez vous adapter à divers contextes, aux imprévus, aux variations de charge de travail.
Vous possédez d'excellentes compétences relationnelles, un sens de l'accueil d'une communication bienveillante.

The dialysis nurse provides comprehensive nursing care to patients with end-stage renal disease who are being maintained by hemodialysis in either a chronic unit setting or an acute intensive care unit setting.

Either area requires the nurse to provide treatment utilizing the nursing process, according to the written procedures and policies of hemodialysis unit. Primary responsibilities include, but may not be limited to: Appropriate use of safe patient handling equipment.

Adheres to infection control practices while using equipment and providing patient care. Follows established SOP's and checklists in the set-up, cleaning, transporting, and storing reusable medical equipment (RME). Safely utilize and maintain VA property and equipment. Obtains and assesses equipment and supplies.

Maintains ability to explain the Hemodialysis process to the patients. Assesses patient in a systematic head to toe format utilizing subjective and objective data and documents findings in the Hemodialysis record. Obtains and records vital signs. Obtains pre-dialysis weight and compares to weight from the last treatment.

Maintains ability to identify specific nursing diagnoses based on nursing assessment: plans care and expected outcomes for each diagnosis and documents findings on appropriate dialysis forms. Reviews laboratory data, x-rays, and compares data to previous findings and notifies physician of abnormal findings or acute changes.

Checks dialysis orders for the following: Correct dialyzer, dialysate, frequency and hours of dialysis. Blood flow rate, dialysate flow rate, dry weight. Lab work to be drawn pre and post-dialysis. Medications to be given during and post dialysis. Transfusion orders. Any other order according to hospital or unit policy.

Verifies consent for procedures. Determines what access is to be utilized for treatment, assesses vascular access and documents findings. Monitors patient and equipment throughout dialysis via assessment of the following parameters. Administers blood products safely per protocol. Demonstrates the ability to collect blood tests.

Administers IV, IM, SC, & PO medications safely before, during and/or after dialysis according to physician order and documents appropriately.

Assesses patient for hemodynamic stability In addition, Dialysis RN's assigned to the primary acute dialysis RN role will maintain these additional skill sets/competences: Will maintain competencies to set up, initiate, monitor, and terminate continuous renal replacement therapies using above safe and effective practice guidelines.

Will maintain competency to set up, initiative, monitor, and terminate plasma exchange therapies using above safe and effective practice guidelines.

Will maintain competency to set up, initiate, monitor, and terminate conventional hemodialysis therapies on critically ill patients in the ICU utilizing portable RO equipment using above safe and effective practice guidelines.

Will rotate on-call responsibilities and accessibility with co-workers to provide 24/7 coverage for emergency therapies and education, training, and support of ward staff to ensure safe patient care.
